post.description: Official match results for one completed WTT/ITTF event, identified by its numeric event id (from `events`). Returns every official match with round, start time and, by default, the full match card (competitors, game scores, winner). Filter by sub-event (MS, WS, MD, WD, XD, MT, WT, XT) and round (FNL, SFNL, QFNL, 8FNL, R32, R64, RND1.., GP). Events still in progress or not yet archived return an upstream not-found error.

event_id.description:
WTT event id, e.g. 3246 for Europe Smash Sweden 2026.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 99999999.

include_scores.description: Embed the shaped match card under `match`; false returns the index only.

round.description: FNL, SFNL, QFNL, 8FNL, R32, R64, R128, RND1, RND2, RND3 or GP (any group; GP01.. for one group).

sub_event.description:
Men/Women Singles, Men/Women/Mixed Doubles, Men/Women/Mixed Team.

Provider reference: allowed values ["MS", "WS", "MD", "WD", "XD", "MT", "WT", "XT"].

take.description:
Maximum matches returned, latest first.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 50.

post.description: Search the WTT/ITTF tournament calendar (2022 to date, including scheduled events). Input optionally narrows by season year, free-text name/city/country and three-letter association code; returns event ids (needed by event_results and match), names, tier, dates, venue and sub-events, latest first.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against event name, city and country name.

post.description: Current ITTF world ranking list. Input selects senior (SEN, default) or youth (YOU) category, the list (MS/WS singles, MD/WD/XD doubles pairs, MDI/WDI/XDI doubles individual; default MS), an optional youth age group (U19, U17, U15, U13, U11) and an optional association filter. Returns rank, previous rank, points, player or pair identity and the publication date of the week in force.

category

event.description:
event

Provider reference: allowed values ["MS", "WS", "MD", "WD", "XD", "MDI", "WDI", "XDI"]; default "MS".
